absdef_l3: Fine ash has worked its way into every seam of this dark sensor package. The underside smells of hot stone, a stubborn reminder of Korriban's furnaces that no amount of scrubbing quite removes.
absdef_w2: Hammer marks overlap beneath the scorched finish of this heavy plating. Its smith left the anvil's rough workmanship visible, as though polished metal were an admission that it had never faced a real trial.
absdef_w3: A heavy forge-plated servo, hammered thick enough to turn aside blows that would shatter lesser armor.
absdef_w4: The gripper joints of this servo are blackened where forge heat has bitten through their finish. Its broad housing carries the tiny pits left by flying sparks and impatient hammer work.
adamguard_l3: This work sensor package has been pried, rewired, and knocked loose by tools far too greasy to care about appearances. A clean strip inside the visor is the only evidence that someone occasionally washes it.
adamguard_w2: Mismatched salvage plates sit on a stout frame, their old mounting holes still visible beside newer rivets. On CZ-220, a secondhand panel is only scrap until somebody finds another use for it.
adamguard_w3: A servo pieced together from riveted salvage plates. Crude, but it holds.
adamguard_w4: This servo has been patched where metal edges repeatedly cut the gripper pads. The repairs are ugly, but a scavenger hauling another load out of CZ-220 has little reason to admire the welds.
adren_harness: A maze of narrow cable runs beneath the panels of this field plating. Each can be adjusted without removing the others, a small mercy when the droid has more urgency than patience.
advent_bracer: A sturdy servo favored by those setting out on new ventures across the galaxy.
agent_gloves: This servo has few distinguishing marks and no loose housing to catch on a latch. Its maker seems to have considered being remembered an unnecessary defect in a useful piece of equipment.
agent_tunic: Subdued plating with concealed fasteners and tool bays that lie flat when empty. It could pass through a crowded starport without attracting a second glance, which is much of its appeal.
alpharhy_l1: Narrow cords draw this sensor package close around the dome, leaving little to rattle against the brush. Along its edge, repeated weld marks suggest the steady beat of treads moving together through Dathomir's undergrowth.
alpharhy_l8: Bands of dark hide cross the gripper pads of this servo, their seams welded in a repeating, heartbeat-like pattern. Beneath the jungle grime, the gripper joints have polished smooth around a well-used grip. The rhythm is a hunter's reminder: wait, breathe, strike.
alpharhy_w1: Hide straps and braided cords hold this plating close to the chassis frame. Its bindings repeat the same measured pattern, like a hunting chant made tangible and carried into Dathomir's tangled wilds.
alpharhy_w3: A servo that thrums faintly with a steady, heartbeat-like pulse.
apexbite_l1: Small fang-shaped toggles keep this close-fitting sensor package fastened. Old claw marks score the outer shell; whatever first tore them was considerably less interested in the housing than in the lenses beneath it.
apexbite_l8: The grippers of this servo have been overlaid with rough hide, while narrow ridges run along the joints. Its maker understood the difference between ornamental fangs and something meant to hold on.
apexbite_w1: Tough hide panels overlap across this hunting plating, leaving the upper joints free. Teeth and old scratches have been left visible rather than dressed away, an account of Dathomir written in scars.
apexbite_w3: A servo studded with the fangs of a predator that did not go down easily.
apprentice_dark_: Dark apprentice plating with an edge still stiff enough to betray its relative newness. Its severity is deliberate, an early lesson in looking certain before the droid has earned much reason to be.
ar_armor: Broad panels meet at severe angles across the front of this plating. Even its smallest clasps look deliberately substantial, making the whole feel like an argument that the droid intends to finish.
ar_bracer: A well-made servo of a design common among the guards of Argos.
asc_bul_armor: The joints of this plating are nested carefully beneath overlapping plates. Its maker spent as much effort on the quiet spaces between the metal as on the surfaces a buyer would first admire.
asc_bul_bracer: A layered servo built to absorb punishment and keep its droid standing.
asc_chn_gloves: Fine welds trace the gripper joints of this servo without disturbing its clean lines. It has the restrained finish of equipment intended to be seen by students as well as fitted in the field.
asc_chn_tunic: This plating's light outer panels conceal a disciplined arrangement of seams and fasteners. It looks formal without relying on ornament, the work of a fabricator who knew that composure must survive movement.
asc_skm_gloves: Supple panels cover this servo, while heavier welds gather around the joints. Its neat workmanship carries a quiet confidence, with little decoration to distract from the gripper it drives.
asc_skm_tunic: Every visible seam of this plating has been welded close and flat. The silhouette remains spare even where its inner layer grows more substantial, leaving its quality to be discovered rather than advertised.
banecallerda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Banecaller Vex.
banecallerdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Banecaller Vex.
barrel_shroud: A vented barrel servo that keeps a heavy weapon fast and true.
barrieroverseda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Barrier Overseer.
barrieroversedb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Barrier Overseer.
beaconmarksda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Beacon Marksman Rell.
beaconmarksdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Beacon Marksman Rell.
beasthide: Supple beasthide plating that keeps a hunting droid mobile.
biolab_boots: A sealed laboratory drive unit from the station's research wing. It guards against Force attacks and helps the droid recover Force energy.
biolab_cap: A sealed sensor package used in the station's research labs. Its filters keep the droid's processors clear, deepening its Force reserves and sharpening its Force techniques.
biolab_gloves: A sealed laboratory servo from the station's research wing. It guards against Force attacks and steadies the droid's Force techniques.
biolab_tunic: A long casing from the station's reanimation trials, still stiff with dried reagents. It wards off Force attacks and sharpens the droid's Force techniques.
bipod_rig: A stabilized bipod servo that steadies aim and balance.
blackoutwrdda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Blackout Warden.
blackoutwrddb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Blackout Warden.
blast_harness: A vented plating frame that shunts blast pressure aside, trading coverage for mobility.
blast_vest: A reinforced plating layered against shrapnel and concussion.
bleddry_gloves: Dark discoloration runs into the seams of this servo, surviving every attempt to clean it. The hide housing is sound, but its history is harder to scrub out than its owner might wish.
bm_armor: The plates of this shell have been refitted around old dents rather than replaced outright. Their careful alignment suggests a veteran who knows exactly which pieces are worth keeping.
bm_bracer: A servo favored by seasoned fighters who have outlasted many battles.
bm_helmet: It's rusty and junky and hard to see through.
bone_guard: A servo guard carved from ridged apex-beast bone.
brawl_wraps: Weighted servo housings that add teeth to every blow.
broodguard_ring: A socket plug carved from the chitin of a Qion Hive broodmother. It is lighter than it looks and very hard to scratch.
bunkerbreakda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Bunker Breaker Vos.
bunkerbreakdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Bunker Breaker Vos.
byysk_armor: Rough, layered sections give this plating the severe outline favored by Byysk fighters. Its lashings have been tightened repeatedly, leaving a history of use more persuasive than polished parade metal.
byysk_bracer: A servo fashioned by the Byysk from hardened slug carapace.
canopy_band: A dark alloy socket plug fitted by a hunter who worked the Dathomir canopy unseen. The inner face is scored with tally marks.
canyonbulwrkda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Canyon Bulwark Grok.
canyonbulwrkdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Canyon Bulwark Grok.
cara_armor: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy plating which often proves surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_boots: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy tread housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_bracer: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy servo housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_cap: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy sensor housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_gloves: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy servo housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_headdress: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy sensor housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_helmet: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy sensor housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_leggings: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy tread housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_robes: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy plating which often proves surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_shoes: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy tread housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_tunic: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy plating which often proves surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
cara_wraps: The elites and chieftains amongst the Byysks would harvest molted or fallen carapaces from matured slugs and fashion them into thick and sturdy servo housings which often prove surprisingly resistant to acid and poison.
caravan_sash: A sun-bleached power cell wrapped in bantha wool, fitted by the caravan masters of Anchorhead and marked with a tally of safe crossings.
ch_armor: The panels of this plating overlap in an unsettling, asymmetrical pattern. Its smith made every joint fit, but appears to have taken particular pleasure in making none of them look orderly.
ch_bracer: A jagged, mismatched servo that seems to have been assembled without any plan at all.
chef_bracer_1: This practical servo housing keeps a chef's droid arm clear of the work without adding much ceremony to the uniform. Fine marks near the joint recall countless hurried reaches across a crowded preparation bench.
chef_bracer_2: Soft velveteen padding gives this kitchen servo a more polished appearance than a plain work housing. Its fastening remains practical, a reminder that a well-presented chef is still expected to finish dinner.
chef_bracer_3: Smooth silk trim has been mounted around the edge of this carefully fitted servo. The neat finish suits a formal kitchen, where the presentation of the meal begins well before a guest sees a plate.
chef_bracer_4: The padding of this kitchen servo has softened without losing the shape of its careful welds. It has the reassuring look of something that has survived several fashionable menus and their less fashionable cleanup.
chef_bracer_5: Deeply colored panels and a restrained decorative seam distinguish this chef's servo. The ornament stays above the joint, leaving the busy end of the unit admirably free of distractions.
chemslingerda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Chem Slinger Ovo.
chemslingerdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Chem Slinger Ovo.
chieftain_torc: A heavy logic board of cold-forged metal installed by a Byysk chieftain. Ice has pitted it, but the clan marks are still sharp.
cnt_armor: Plating bolted onto the station's containment droids when the outbreak began. It absorbs heavy blows and steadies the droid's strikes.
cnt_bracer: An armored servo guard from a containment team's kit. It turns aside heavy blows and braces the droid's strikes.
cnt_helmet: A sealed sensor package issued to the station's containment teams. Its armored shell turns aside heavy blows, and the lens array's threat overlay sharpens the droid's strikes.
cnt_leggings: An armored drive unit built to hold a quarantine line. It absorbs heavy blows and keeps the droid's balance steady when it strikes.
cnt_rifle: A blaster mount from the station's armory, issued to the units that held the quarantine line. Its sights steady the droid's aim.
cnt_staff: A reinforced riot shock prod from the station's armory, made to drive the infected back without getting close. Its balance steadies the droid's strikes.
com_gloves: Stout grip pads and closely fitted housings give this servo the practical finish of field equipment. Its only decoration is the grain of the leather, visible where repeated use has burnished it.
com_tunic: This service plating keeps its fasteners close and its excess bulk to a minimum. It is the sort of part that gets packed before a journey and stays on when the journey stops going to plan.
conduitmatrnda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Conduit Matron.
conduitmatrndb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Conduit Matron.
conveyor_treads: A drive unit fitted with conveyor-line tread. It grips any floor and keeps the droid moving out of harm's way.
cook_armor_1: A chef's working plating with a clean front and cable runs that gather neatly above the manipulator arms. Its real distinction is less visible: reinforced seams in the places a long service is most likely to test.
cook_armor_2: Velveteen adds a quiet richness to this culinary plating. Beneath the soft finish, its seals and seams remain firmly concerned with the work of feeding guests rather than merely greeting them.
cook_armor_3: The smooth outer panels of this silk-finished plating have been fitted for a chef who works in view of their guests. Careful fabrication keeps an elegant appearance from becoming an obstacle at a busy counter.
cook_armor_4: Repeated scrubbing has softened this kitchen plating's older finish into a comfortable patina. Its careful repairs suggest a unit kept through years of changing tastes and unchanging demands for another course.
cook_armor_5: Subtle color and close-set seams give this chef's plating a reserved elegance. The workmanship would be at home in an expensive dining room, though its practical tool bays remember the kitchen.
crimson_wraps: Crimson strips overlap across this servo's housing in a pattern scuffed almost smooth at the joints. The bright plating catches the eye even when the gripper beneath it remains perfectly still.
cryptwardenda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Expedition Raider Nihl.
cryptwardendb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Expedition Raider Nihl.
cycloneadptda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Cyclone Training Droid.
cycloneadptdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Cyclone Training Droid.
dan_heavy_armor: Layers of roughly worked hide and heavy bindings make up this Dantari plating. The repairs are as much a part of its construction as the original pieces, recording life beyond the colony's comfortable walls.
dan_hyper_gloves: This Dantari servo is fastened with hide ties instead of buckles. Each knot has been worked to lie flat, the kind of small refinement learned by fitting a part to a droid rather than drawing it on a workbench.
dancer_wraps: This servo has been wound to leave the gripper free and the joint closely bound. Its wire ends tuck away beneath older layers, where a sudden turn cannot send them trailing across a fighting pit.
darkhung_l3: Strips of pale wrapping lie across this dark sensor package like exposed ribs. In a ruined corridor, the unit could easily be mistaken for another bundle of bones until the wrapping began to move.
darkhung_w2: Dark plates rise from this plating in severe, uneven layers. Scraped edges show pale beneath the finish, like old bones breaking through the soil of a neglected burial ground.
darkhung_w3: A servo housing carved from bone and bound with sinew, still stained from the hunt.
darkhung_w4: This heavy servo has narrow gaps between its blackened gripper plates. Dust settles deep in the joints, where even a careful cleaning leaves a little of the tomb behind.
deadhand_l3: Sun-faded wrapping has been bound twice around the lens housing of this trail sensor package. Fine Tatooine grit falls from the seams whenever it is shaken, with more always waiting underneath.
deadhand_w2: The straps of this ridge-scarred plating have been shortened and punched with fresh holes. It was fitted by someone who expected long climbs, hard landings, and very little help from anyone below.
deadhand_w3: A battered servo once fitted to a gunslinger who never missed twice.
deadhand_w4: This servo is scuffed smooth inside and scoured rough outside. Its old hide casing stiffens in the cool desert night, carrying a silence quite different from the heat of the day's hunt.
deadhandzephda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Dead Hand Zeph.
deadhandzephdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Dead Hand Zeph.
deccommand_l1: The back of this sensor package sits neatly above the body shell, clear of headset leads and equipment mounts. Its severe welds look more at home beneath a command deck's lights than under an open sky.
deccommand_l8: Repeated contact with console keys has polished the gripper tips of this servo. Small weld repairs around the joint show where a duty panel once caught it during a hurried reach across a control panel.
deccommand_w1: Flat straps keep this plating close enough to fit among crowded consoles. Its clasps are dull with use, the kind of unobtrusive equipment that stays on through a shift which was supposed to end hours ago.
deccommand_w3: A servo fitted with a relay module that can override nearby command signals.
decurioncmdda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Decurion Commander.
decurioncmddb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Decurion Commander.
deton_cestus: A charged servo that turns each strike into a small blast.
dhar005k: Broad armored panels and substantial mounting lugs give this droid shell its heavy, industrial outline. Every accessible edge has been patiently finished, bringing even routine maintenance to the standard of the completed shell. An additional letter on the serial stamp identifies a separately finished version of the usual assembly.
dhar005s: Broad armored panels and substantial mounting lugs give this droid shell its heavy, industrial outline. Every accessible edge has been patiently finished, bringing even routine maintenance to the standard of the completed shell. An additional letter on the serial stamp identifies a separately finished version of the usual assembly.
dhbr005k: A reinforced servo housing engineered to bolt onto a droid chassis, upgraded with improved shielding.
dhbr005s: A reinforced servo housing engineered to bolt onto a droid chassis, upgraded with improved shielding.
director_coat: The station director's field plating, fitted through the final reanimation trials. Its inner layer wards off Force attacks and lends the droid's Force techniques the director's cold precision.
director_signet: The station director's command plug, still keyed to the research wing's locks. It guards the droid and sharpens its Force techniques.
dlar005k: Closely fitted panels leave this light droid shell a spare, compact outline around its chassis mounts. Every accessible edge has been patiently finished, bringing even routine maintenance to the standard of the completed shell. An additional letter on the serial stamp identifies a separately finished version of the usual assembly.
dlar005s: Closely fitted panels leave this light droid shell a spare, compact outline around its chassis mounts. Every accessible edge has been patiently finished, bringing even routine maintenance to the standard of the completed shell. An additional letter on the serial stamp identifies a separately finished version of the usual assembly.
dlbr005k: This slim droid servo assembly encloses its fittings beneath carefully seated panels, leaving the working joints clear. Every accessible edge has been patiently finished, bringing even routine maintenance to the standard of the completed shell. An additional letter on the serial stamp identifies a separately finished version of the usual assembly.
dlbr005s: This slim droid servo assembly encloses its fittings beneath carefully seated panels, leaving the working joints clear. Every accessible edge has been patiently finished, bringing even routine maintenance to the standard of the completed shell. An additional letter on the serial stamp identifies a separately finished version of the usual assembly.
dream_bracer: A smooth, lightweight servo that feels almost weightless on the droid's arm.
duel_grip: The gripper pads of this servo are smooth from a familiar hilt, while its housing remains carefully finished. It suggests a duelist who considers the moments before a bout part of the encounter.
dunedeadeyeda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Deadeye of the Dunes.
dunedeadeyedb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Deadeye of the Dunes.
dunescout_boots: A soft-tread drive unit with sealed housings, made for crossing loose sand without a sound. Favored by scouts who need to stay light and quick.
dunescout_glove: Close-fitting servo with sand-grip pads, machined to keep a blaster steady through heat shimmer and blowing grit.
ec_armor: Dark plates catch the light along the edges of this Eclipse plating and leave its recessed surfaces in shadow. Its carefully arranged layers turn that simple contrast into a severe, deliberate silhouette.
ec_bracer: A dark servo etched with the image of a sun swallowed by shadow.
eclipse_l3: This bone-trimmed sensor package seems to have collected the dust of every crypt it passed through. The pale edging makes its seams look deeper and darker by comparison.
eclipse_w2: Crypt dust clings to the recessed channels of this plating. Its dark finish has been rubbed thin over the central housing, where a previous droid repeatedly rested its manipulator arm before rolling into the next chamber.
eclipse_w3: A shadowed servo taken from a sealed sepulcher, cold to the touch.
eclipse_w4: Pale welds disappear beneath the overlapping plates of this dark servo. It creaks softly when flexed, a small, living sound in places that otherwise have none.
eclipseshadeda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Umbral Relic Broker.
eclipseshadedb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Umbral Relic Broker.
embunker_l1: A fine mesh has been welded between the layers of this utilitarian sensor package. Loose ends have been tucked away with the same care a bunker technician might give a fraying cable.
embunker_l8: The casing of this work servo is laced with flattened strips of conductive mesh. Its housing bears the cramped, scrawled marks of someone who labelled equipment before trusting it near a conduit.
embunker_w1: Insulated cables cross this plating in a tidy grid, broken by stout, workmanlike clasps. Old maintenance marks survive along the inner edge, where a bunker crew could read them without removing the entire rig.
embunker_w3: A servo built around a compact pulse generator that hums when braced for impact.
emcocktail_l1: This sensor package's pale underside has been carefully scrubbed, though the outer casing retains the marks of hard service. Its mounting straps are long enough to fasten quickly, even by a tired technician in a cramped triage ward.
emcocktail_l8: The gripper tips of this servo are cut and welded for close work. Several faint stains have outlasted repeated cleaning, a quiet record of the patients who could not wait for a fresh unit.
emcocktail_w1: The lower edge of this service plating is darkened by dusty stairs and long sublevel corridors. Its tool bays have been repaired more carefully than its ornamentation; somebody depended on what they carried.
emcocktail_w3: A servo laced with conductive filaments that crackle with stray charge.
enclavesentlda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Enclave Security Droid.
enclavesentldb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Enclave Security Droid.
engi_armor_1: A straightforward workshop plating with seams that show the maker's careful first decisions. A few extra welds reinforce the tool bays, where tools have a habit of teaching an apprentice what a pattern book omitted.
engi_armor_2: This work plating has broad tool bays and fasteners easy to manage with tired manipulators. Its modest finish suits the technician who would rather have another useful tool than another unnecessary ornament.
engi_armor_3: The tool bays of this mechanic's plating have been arranged within easy reach of both manipulator arms. Sturdy welds follow their lower edges, anticipating the weight of whatever the next repair requires.
engi_armor_4: Workshop plating whose restrained finish conceals unusually patient welding. It reflects the kind of devotion found in doing a difficult job properly even when no customer will see the inside.
engi_armor_5: This finely worked plating keeps a craftsman's practical cut while giving its seams an almost immaculate finish. The result would survive inspection at a formal presentation without looking out of place beside an open droid chassis.
engi_bracer_1: A plainly made work servo, carefully fitted so that it does not interfere with the joint. It has the earnest finish of an apprentice learning that useful equipment need not look complicated.
engi_bracer_2: Tough casing and an uncomplicated latch make this servo easy to keep in service. The inside is smoother than the outside, giving a worker one small comfort over a long shift.
engi_bracer_3: This mechanic's servo keeps loose cables clear of moving parts. Its outer surface has room to accumulate the small scuffs that any honest piece of workshop equipment eventually earns.
engi_bracer_4: Patient welding follows the edge of this workshop servo. Its construction suggests a maker who returned to every seam until the work felt right, even where no buyer would think to look.
engi_bracer_5: The seams of this servo are dressed so closely that the fastening almost disappears into its outline. Its refined finish offers a craftsman a rare piece of work they need not immediately improve upon.
espn_belt_1: A grease-darkened power cell that seats without a click and never hums. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_belt_2: A power cell in a webbing housing with padded bays sized for charges, primers, and wire spools. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_belt_3: A power cell wrapped in light-drinking filament; the edges of the unit seem to smudge into shadow. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_belt_4: A coiled power cell of segmented plates hiding needle sheaths and primer pockets in equal measure. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_belt_5: A full power cell rig of calibrated tools: cutters, primers, bypass spikes, and a fold-out brace for steady work. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_neck_1: A logic module wired with a loop of decommissioned keycards on braided wire, each one shaved thin enough to slip a maintenance latch. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_neck_2: A miniature prybar cast in durasteel, mounted on a logic board by dockyard thieves for luck and, occasionally, for work. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_neck_3: A logic module with a cracked monocular on a leather cord. The crack, hunters swear, is what teaches the eye to catch movement. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_neck_4: A logic module engraved with the lock-sigils of nine plundered vaults, one for each the maker opened. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_neck_5: A matte-black logic module that seems to mute the light around the droid's dome. Its previous owners were never caught - only betrayed. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_ring_1: A dull socket plug with a pinhole lens set where a status light should be. Someone used this to keep quiet count of everyone who passed. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_ring_2: A socket plug with a hairline emitter that swallows the sound of steps a half-second after they land. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_ring_3: A plug of green glass with a hollow reservoir; a twist of the bezel wets the droid's blade. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_ring_4: A cold socket plug cut from Korriban tomb-stone. Shadows sit a little heavier around any unit that carries it. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
espn_ring_5: A socket plug set with a sliver of polished dark crystal. Things that do not wish to be seen feel it looking anyway. Found only in sealed lockboxes.
eternal_bracer: An old servo of timeless design that shows no sign of weathering.
eyestorm_bracer: A servo prized by fighters who stay calm at the center of a brawl.
eyewall_harness: Overlapping panels curve around this plating's center like a storm closing around its eye. The inner straps are plain and practical, providing an unexpectedly quiet core to the design.
fabr_armor_1: A plain plating made with the steady economy of a working fabricator. The seams are easy to follow, leaving little doubt about where a future repair will need to begin.
fabr_armor_2: The linen finish of this plating has a pleasing, irregular grain. Its practical cut gives the panels room to settle with use, trading a stiff new appearance for the comfort of something used often.
fabr_armor_3: Carefully placed seams give this plating its distinctive outline without depending on lavish decoration. Its designer seems to have understood that an interesting silhouette still needs to remain serviceable.
fabr_armor_4: The light, easy curves of this plating recall shade reached after a long walk in the heat. Its fabrication leaves room to move without allowing the panels to collect in an untidy burden.
fabr_armor_5: A delicate border follows this plating's seams, lending a floral suggestion without turning the part into a costume. The restrained pattern rewards a closer look rather than demanding one.
fabr_bracer_1: Several close layers of padding make this unassuming servo more substantial than it appears. Its welded edges are easy to maintain, the practical beginning of a maker's kit.
fabr_bracer_2: The natural grain of its linen-fiber casing gives this work servo a modest texture. Its cleanly bound edges keep the fibers orderly around a joint that is unlikely to remain idle for long.
fabr_bracer_3: This servo uses the placement of its seams as its principal decoration. It is a small example of a designer finding something worth admiring in a piece meant for daily work.
fabr_bracer_4: A light casing and a softly padded inner edge make this servo gentle on the arm joint. Its relaxed finish suggests a brief patch of shade in the middle of a demanding working day.
fabr_bracer_5: A narrow floral border follows this servo's outer edge, kept well clear of the fastening. It lends a personal touch to practical equipment without asking the droid to treat it delicately.
fdybreak_bracer: A servo cut from the armor plate of the Hutlar foundry's overseer and fitted to a droid arm.
flameweaverda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Ascendant Flameweaver.
flameweaverdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Ascendant Flameweaver.
fld_bul_armor: This plating's broad outer panels are scarred most heavily along the sides and upper edges. It has the look of equipment that spent long hours standing where somebody else needed a barrier.
fld_bul_bracer: A practical servo issued to wardens who hold the line in the field.
fld_bul_helm: It's rusty and junky and hard to see through.
fld_chn_gloves: This servo carries restrained markings etched almost invisibly into its casing. Their meaning matters more to the droid than to anyone trying to decipher them across a room.
fld_chn_tunic: Loose outer panels hide the fasteners of this plating, leaving its front unusually uninterrupted. Its quiet construction recalls the travelling kit of someone who values a little distance from the crowd.
fld_skm_gloves: This field servo has reinforced gripper pads and casing edges thinned by repeated adjustment. It looks ready to be bolted on while everyone else is still deciding who should go first.
fld_skm_tunic: A serviceable plating built around robust upper seams and uncomplicated fasteners. Its cut favors the first droid through a doorway over the last droid to finish being fitted for it.
flesh_gloves: The outer hide of this servo has a coarse, unsettling grain. Close welds hold it firmly around the gripper, turning a savage-looking material into something patiently engineered.
flesh_tunic: Rugged panels give this plating a harsher outline than its careful inner seams suggest. Its maker appears to have valued the effect of a threatening silhouette almost as much as the plating itself.
flurrychampda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Flurry Champion Dax.
flurrychampdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Flurry Champion Dax.
for_gloves: Broad casing edges and a clean line of welds give this servo a decisive appearance. Its gripper pads are plainer, made for the business the gripper must actually perform.
for_tunic: This plating's strong lines are softened by a carefully fitted inner layer. It holds an imposing shape without making every movement look like a negotiation with the panels.
forcebane_l3: The front of this sensor package closes beneath a plain, substantial clasp. Dust from Korriban's proving chambers has gathered behind it, beyond the reach of a hurried brush before the next trial.
forcebane_w2: Heavy plates meet over the front of this plating like the faces of an anvil. The smith has left a small, deliberate hammer impression at the center, a signature that needs no name.
forcebane_w3: A servo tempered in molten trials, its surface rippled from the heat.
forcebane_w4: Heat-darkened plates cover the gripper joints of this forge servo. Its hide casing is deeply creased where generations of the same stubborn grip have taught it how to bend.
forcebeast_l1: Hide and plating meet in irregular seams around this sensor package's lens housing. Its straps carry the scent of the wild long after the rest of a traveller's belongings have lost it.
forcebeast_l8: The gripper joints of this servo are ridged like a beast's half-curled claws. Scratches cross the hide in all directions, making it difficult to tell which were put there by their maker.
forcebeast_w1: Different hides have been bound over this plating with thick, patiently worked cord. Each panel carries its own grain and scars, preserving a little of the creatures that once moved through Dathomir beneath them.
forcebeast_w3: A servo fused with traces of a Force-touched beast's hide.
forgewrightda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Forgewright Malak-Kin.
forgewrightdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Forgewright Malak-Kin.
frontier_bracer: A rugged servo made for life on the edges of settled space.
gaffi_bracer: A heavy servo of layered bantha hide and scavenged durasteel, bound tight so the droid can swing a gaderffii all day without losing grip.
gantry_boots: A mag-tread drive unit from the station's docking gantries. It keeps the droid steady, tireless, and quick to dodge.
gantry_cap: A padded sensor package used by the station's dock and maintenance crews. It keeps the droid alert, tireless, and quick to slip out of harm's way.
gantry_gloves: Grip-lined work servo from the station's docking gantries. It protects the gripper and helps the droid twist away from blows.
gantry_tunic: Reinforced work plating from the station's docking gantries. It protects the droid, builds stamina, and lets the unit twist away from blows.
gatekeep_plate: The broad central plate of this chassis plating leaves an uncompromising silhouette. Its mounting straps have been adjusted for long service, as though its owner expects to spend more time holding a threshold than crossing it.
gr_gloves: This servo has sturdy casing edges with conspicuously easy-to-find fastenings. Its practical construction suggests a droid that expects to be fitted in a hurry and kept in place through rough work.
gr_tunic: Additional welds reinforce the equipment bays of this field plating. Its lower edge has been kept short enough to stay clear of gear hanging from the power rail.
grapple_bracer: A servo built around a salvaged grapple-arm motor. It steadies the droid's strikes and soaks up a share of incoming blows.
guardmst_l3: A careful border of repeated marks runs around this sensor package's opening. The pattern remains neat even where the casing has grown thin, evidence of a discipline maintained long after the first welding.
guardmst_w2: The plain outer plates of this chassis plating conceal an unexpectedly meticulous inner construction. The unit could move from quiet instruction to a training floor without pausing to tighten a loose panel.
guardmst_w3: A broad servo built to take a beating so others do not have to.
guardmst_w4: This servo shows scuffing on its outer joints where repeated guards have rubbed away the finish. Whoever fitted it expected an arm to spend as much time turned aside as reaching forward.
gunsling_rig: A fast-draw servo that steadies aim and reflexes.
hexweave: A charm-wired deflector emitter that sharpens the droid while rattling foes.
hide_warbelt: A thick war power cell in a casing of sun-cured bantha hide hung with trophies. It braces the droid's core against heavy blows.
holdfast_bracer: A firm, heavy servo made for fighters who refuse to give ground.
holdline_l1: The front edge of this field sensor package has been patched with whatever plate was nearest to the bench. No two repairs match, but each kept it in service through one more turn on the line.
holdline_l8: This servo has been mended along the gripper joints where stretcher poles and medical satchels rub hardest. The welds are careful despite the haste that other marks in the casing suggest.
holdline_w1: There is little ceremonial about this plating: shortened edges, reinforced upper panels, and storage bays packed with field supplies. It was made to stay with its droid after a comfortable retreat had ceased to be an option.
holdline_w3: A thick servo meant to brace a shield arm against a charging foe.
hunter_gloves: The seams of this servo have been flattened wherever they might scrape against brush or a weapon grip. Its exterior has the dull, patient scuffing of equipment carried through more than one quiet hunt.
hunter_tunic: Earthy paint and understated fastenings give this plating little to catch a wandering eye. Close up, careful repairs reveal a shell that has spent considerably more time outdoors than in a hangar.
hunter_vambrace: A scarred manipulator servo taken from a bounty hunter who worked the Dune Sea alone. Its plates have turned more than one blade.
imm_gloves: Repairs have become so thoroughly worked into this servo that it is difficult to identify the oldest casing. Its name has outlasted several grippers and probably a number of owners.
imm_tunic: Several generations of welds lie beneath this plating's outer seams. A technician might call it overdue for replacement; its unit appears to consider continued service the more convincing argument.
infconduit_l3: Narrow channels have been welded into this sensor package to keep loose leads clear of the dome joint. A faint smell of warm insulation lingers in the housing.
infconduit_w2: A dense web of piping lies beneath this plating's outer layers. Its service seams are easy to reach, as if its maker expected repairs to happen beside a conduit rather than in a workshop.
infconduit_w3: A servo forged under high voltage, its metal still faintly charged.
infconduit_w4: The housing seals of this servo have been rewrapped over old scorch marks. Its current owner would be wise to read the marks as a history of the work, rather than a promise about the next live wire.
inq_gloves: The gripper joints of this severe servo have been fitted with particular care, leaving no loose panels. Its finish is immaculate in the places a nervous observer is most likely to notice.
inq_tunic: A high, controlled ridge gives this plating a formal severity. Its carefully concealed fastenings leave the droid looking composed even when everyone nearby has begun to fidget.
invictusda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Ironhold Invictus.
invictusdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Ironhold Invictus.
invinc_l3: Rain has softened the edges of this watch sensor package without loosening its square, regulation seams. It has the look of equipment fitted through many late rounds on Viscara.
invinc_w2: This marshal's plating balances its weight between broad mounting straps. Scuffing gathers around the fastenings, where duty rigs and other reminders of authority have been clamped on before another patrol.
invinc_w3: A riot-line servo built to take blow after blow without buckling.
invinc_w4: This servo has broad, unadorned joints and casing edges polished by repeated use. Its severity requires no insignia to suggest the firm grip of a warden.
isolation_shroud: A layered isolation emitter fitted to the droids of researchers handling live infection samples. Its field dampens incoming Force attacks.
jammer_array: A weathered jammer array that sharpens strikes while scrambling foes.
killbeacon_l1: The front of this sensor package has been trimmed to sit beneath a targeting array. Its old seams show where someone made small adjustments and then made them again.
killbeacon_l8: The gripper pads of this servo are thick with careful repairs. Traces of packing dust remain inside the casing, along with the scuffing left by repeatedly lifting heavy ordnance into place.
killbeacon_w1: Equipment loops are distributed across this plating with a planner's precision. Empty loops look almost untidy, as though their owner would immediately notice a missing part of the loadout.
killbeacon_w3: A servo fitted with a strike relay that paints targets for allied fire.
killbox_l3: A practical sensor package with a shortened front and close-set straps. Its casing has picked up the faint, stubborn smell of an ordnance bench, even in places where the plating is otherwise clean.
killbox_w2: This plating has been rebalanced more than once, judging by the extra bolt holes around its straps. Someone took the trouble to find out exactly how it sat before trusting it in a proving ground.
killbox_w3: A servo favored by fighters who turn narrow corridors into killing grounds.
killbox_w4: The trigger digit of this servo flexes easily, while the rest of each gripper pad is heavily reinforced. Its restrained workmanship speaks of habits learned around triggers, where carelessness has a very short future.
kwi_heavy_armor: Heavy, overlapping sections give this Kwi plating its stubborn shape. The interior has been worked smooth where that rough construction would otherwise rub, a concession to the droid carrying it.
kwi_heavy_bracer: A heavy servo housing reinforced with thick plates, made to protect the manipulator arm during close combat.
kwi_hyper_gloves: These Kwi servos are strongly sealed at the arm joints but leave the gripper surprisingly supple. The contrast becomes apparent only when they are lifted from a counter and bolted on.
kwi_hyper_tunic: The substantial construction of this Kwi plating is most evident around its upper edge. Beneath the outer panels, closely worked welds keep its weight from pulling the shell out of shape.
kwi_light_gloves: Light hide plating and narrow housings keep these Kwi servos close to the manipulator arm. Their neatly secured wiring suggests a maker who had no interest in letting a loose cable spoil a quick movement.
kwi_light_tunic: This Kwi plating uses thinner panels and sparing fastenings to keep its silhouette lean. Its repairs follow the original seams closely, preserving a fit somebody clearly took trouble to achieve.
kwi_spirit_charm: A knot of bone, feather and river stone taken from a Kwi shaman circle and bound into a logic module. It still carries a faint hum of the rites worked over it.
lab_bracer: A servo housing scorched and stained by the spills of a filthy laboratory.
lastword_l3: Desert sunlight has bleached the raised ridges of this sensor package almost colorless. Underneath, darker plating preserves the outline of its first life before Tatooine began grinding it down.
lastword_w2: The outer plates of this plating bear shallow, oblique scars. Its unit seems to have spent a great deal of time among hard stone and flying fragments, with little interest in polishing away the evidence.
lastword_w3: A slim servo that keeps the gun arm free for a fast draw.
lastword_w4: Deep creases run across the gripper pads of these servos where a familiar weapon rested. The gripper digits are scuffed unevenly, a signature of the arm that steadied it through long watches in the heat.
lattice_plate: Body plating threaded with a fault-detection lattice that hardens where it is struck.
lightstand_l3: Small pieces of worked bone interrupt the edging of this ritual sensor package. They click softly against one another when the plating is lifted, breaking the silence of a tomb by a little too much.
lightstand_w2: Pale inlays trace the joints of this dark plate like a second skeleton. Dust has lodged around each one, preserving the outlines even where the plating's finish has been scoured away.
lightstand_w3: A ceremonial servo assembly fitted by the wardens of an old ritual site.
lightstand_w4: Bone-colored welds cross these servos from joint to gripper. Their dark casings look almost black beside the seams, especially in the uncertain light of a crypt.
line_visor: An assembly-line calibration sensor package that overlays aim corrections on the droid's view.
lockdown_bracer: A heavy servo fitted with a door-breaching ram plate. Security officers used it to force sealed hatches during lockdowns.
majestic_bracer: An ornate servo assembly fit for nobility, as protective as it is striking.
mando_armor: The upper edges of this plating broaden its outline without hiding the care taken over its fit. Its plain, substantial finish speaks of a guardian's duty more readily than any ceremonial inscription could.
mando_bracer: A Mandalorian-style servo built to guard the manipulator arm in close combat.
mando_helmet: It's rusty and junky and hard to see through.
markahungerda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Vitae Reaver Vark.
markahungerdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Vitae Reaver Vark.
oneshot_l3: The opening of this sensor package is drawn back from the lenses and held there by small, careful welds. It bears the patient scuffing of long watches spent looking at the same distant patch of ground.
oneshot_w2: The upper mount of this marksman's plating has been worked smoother than the rest. A previous owner repeatedly altered the fit until the unit's familiar stance stopped fighting the plating.
oneshot_w3: A steady servo that keeps a marksman's aim true.
oneshot_w4: The trigger digits of these servos have been repaired with finer parts than their gripper pads. Each small adjustment suggests an owner who could feel a difference that a casual buyer would never notice.
ord_rig: A targeting servo that sharpens aim and keeps the unit light on its treads.
outlaw_gloves: These servos have mismatched repairs and clamps that can be tightened with a single pull. The previous owner apparently preferred workable equipment to anything that might invite questions about its origin.
outlaw_tunic: Weathered plating with replacement fastenings and storage bays packed with an assortment of small necessities. It looks quite at home among people who regard official supply channels as somebody else's problem.
overbarr_l1: A heavy visor flap shades the lenses while short straps keep the rest of this sensor package close. Powdery debris works loose from its seams, the residue of duties carried out well behind the first report of gunfire.
overbarr_l8: These loader's servos are battered at the heel of each gripper pad. Long, ugly scuffs tell of ammunition crates dragged into reach rather than patiently carried around every obstruction.
overbarr_w1: Broad straps spread the weight of a crowded loadout across this plating. Its clasps have been turned inward to avoid catching on the equipment that always seems to be piled around a bombardment position.
overbarr_w3: A heavy servo built to brace against the recoil of sustained fire.
padded_coat: Padded plating that keeps the droid light and covered.
perflurry_l3: Pale plating has been wrapped over the darker underside of this weathered sensor package. Its straps are stiff with repeated exposure, well suited to the sort of cold that punishes every uncovered seam on Hutlar.
perflurry_w2: This plating has been repaired beneath its outer panels, keeping the worst of its scuffing out of the wind. The careful layering suggests a unit that learned Hutlar's weather through experience.
perflurry_w3: A light servo that leaves the manipulator arm free for rapid casting.
perflurry_w4: A double layer of plating covers the backs of these servos, while the gripper pads remain supple from use. Their most precise repairs sit around the gripper digits, where cold and impatience are equally unwelcome.
pitguard_wraps: Old arena dust has settled between the layers of this servo housing. The inner seals have been carefully renewed, while the battered outside remains as a warning against expecting an easy bout.
poach_armor: Dull panels and close-set straps give this plating little to catch on a branch. Its owner appears to have chosen every repair with the intention of getting back into the wild before anyone noticed the absence.
poach_bracer: A scuffed, hide-plated servo favored by poachers who stalk dangerous game.
primover_l1: A strip of pale bone follows the top edge of this watch sensor package. Seen between Dathomir's branches, it gives the unsettling impression that the forest itself has opened an eye.
primover_l8: Curved ridges follow the joints of these close-fitting servo grippers. The pads have been scuffed smooth by gripping weapons, roots, and anything else that let their owner refuse a fall.
primover_w1: The straps of this war plating look almost like the bindings of a restraint until it is lifted and bolted on. The workmanship reflects an overseer's preoccupation with what must stay firmly in place.
primover_w3: A servo pulled from a beast's den, scored with claw marks.
prm_bul_armor: Broad, quiet surfaces give this plating the air of a sentry already at its post. A closer look reveals the small service marks and careful adjustments that keep such a watch from being merely ornamental.
prm_bul_bracer: A finely made servo issued to elite sentinels.
prm_chn_gloves: Fine marks are hidden beneath the turned-back housing plates of these servos. They were made for an owner's own contemplation, not for the audience that impressive equipment sometimes gathers.
prm_chn_tunic: Reserved plating whose interest lies in the details: concealed seals, deliberate seams, and small patterns that only become visible close up. Its maker seems to have understood the value of looking unremarkable from a distance.
prm_skm_gloves: These servos have been adjusted around the gripper digits in ways that depart from a standard pattern. Their owner knew what felt right and apparently felt little obligation to explain the changes to a quartermaster.
prm_skm_tunic: This plating's unconventional fastenings work better than their untidy arrangement suggests. It belongs to the sort of kit assembled according to experience rather than an approved list.
qk_armor: Small fittings and compact plates divide this plating into a surprisingly intricate whole. Its smith seems to have enjoyed making substantial protection out of components that first appear almost insignificant.
qk_bracer: A compact servo threaded with tiny, faintly humming circuits.
quality_signet: A socket plug stamped with the foundry's quality seal. Its embedded field emitter steadies the droid's focus.
quarantine_mask: A sealed medical sensor package from a plague containment ward. Its filters keep the droid's processors clear while focusing the Force.
quill_bracer: A quill-studded servo that sharpens ranged strikes.
quillstalkerda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Quillback Tarn-Stalker.
quillstalkerdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Quillback Tarn-Stalker.
rainsteel_l3: Small punctures mark the outer plating of this sensor package. Each has been closed with a tiny weld, a patient answer to the ugly hazards of Nar Shaddaa's narrow firing lanes.
rainsteel_w2: Fragments have gouged the fittings of this otherwise carefully balanced plating. Its straps remain straight and serviceable, repaired by someone who expected the next trial to be much like the last.
rainsteel_w3: A servo with a built-in dart launcher along the manipulator arm.
rainsteel_w4: The pads of these servos have been marked and re-marked around the gripper digits. Their owner appears to have treated every throw as an adjustment to the next, until the plating itself became a record of practice.
rancorhide_belt: A broad power cell casing cut from the hide of a Dathomir rancor. It took a vibrosaw to shape it and it has not stretched since.
rancorhide_cloak: An emitter housed in plates cut from the reanimated rancor's hide. It is thick enough to absorb blows that would fell a lesser fighter.
reclaim_gaunt: A salvage servo assembly with boosted strikes.
redcrown_plate: A dark red finish follows the raised edges of this plating. The color gives even its bluntest lines a courtly severity, though old scratches make it clear that appearances were not its only occupation.
redvein_wraps: Red welds branch across this servo housing like veins beneath pale plating. The pattern breaks around the joints, where use has scuffed the paint down to the plain, stubborn alloy beneath it.
reefwarden_band: A socket plug of polished reef coral set in sea-weathered durasteel, issued to the wardens who keep Mon Cala's Coral Isles safe for divers.
reg_gloves: The neat housing plates of these servos retain their shape despite the scuffing on their gripper pads. They are well suited to an owner who wishes to keep an air of formality while getting dirty.
reg_tunic: Careful machining gives this plating a composed, almost courtly silhouette. Its practical underside suggests an owner unwilling to leave every difficult task to an attendant.
rhydelalphada: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Rhydel Alpha-Matriarch.
rhydelalphadb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Rhydel Alpha-Matriarch.
riot_harness: Padded riot plating that keeps the droid standing and mobile.
riotvisor_helm: A station security sensor package with a scarred riot visor. Its padded shell absorbs heavy blows, and the visor's targeting overlay steadies the droid's strikes.
ritual_beads: A strand of carved bone beads strung across a logic board for war chants. The rhythm of the beads helps the droid focus through the noise of battle.
riveted_mantle: Overlapping riveted plates mounted around a deflector emitter. Heavy, but it turns aside glancing shots.
ruptorvaneda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Ruptor Vane.
ruptorvanedb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Ruptor Vane.
sabcycl_l3: A repeated spiral runs along the edge of this training sensor package. At the rear, the pattern disappears into a plain weld, giving the eye no obvious place to call its beginning.
sabcycl_w2: Long panels overlap around this plating without leaving much loose metal at the joints. It has been cut for turning maneuvers, with the quiet precision of plating made by somebody who understood the movement.
sabcycl_w3: A servo wrapped in spiraled metal bands that flex with each swing.
sabcycl_w4: The housing plates of these servos turn back in smooth, continuous curves. Fine scratches cross the casing at changing angles, the accumulated record of a blade kept moving.
sabraetrialda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Sabrae Training Engine.
sabraetrialdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Sabrae Training Engine.
sabstorm_l3: This sensor package's casing is darkened along its exposed edges and cleaner where its plates overlap. Its simple fastenings have been replaced several times, while the more deliberate welding has endured.
sabstorm_w2: The lower panels of this plating have been weighted with dense welds. Lifted from a rack, it seems almost still; in motion, its cut becomes much easier to understand.
sabstorm_w3: A servo forged for blade-dancers who move like a storm.
sabstorm_w4: Subtle, branching lines have been etched across these servos. At a glance they resemble decoration, until the joints bend and the pattern breaks apart like a flash of lightning.
sandcall_wraps: Servo housings painted with old clan sigils. Chanters fit them to steady their grip and their minds while leading the war songs.
sandstorm_gaffi: A massive gaderffii shock prod with a flared, weighted tip of beaten durasteel. Tusken war leaders carry weapons like this into battle as a mark of rank.
sc_armor: The surfaces of this plating are restrained, but its inner edges carry patient, deliberate ornament. The workmanship suggests a vow expressed through daily care rather than public display.
sc_bracer: A servo inscribed with old devotional markings.
sc_gloves: These servo housings have been maintained with uncommon patience. Small, orderly repairs follow the same pattern around both joints, giving ordinary scuffing the quiet dignity of a repeated observance.
sc_robes: Plain panels and carefully mended seams give this plating a solemn simplicity. The most intricate welding is hidden inside, where its significance can remain between the droid and its convictions.
sc_tunic: The decoration on this plating is confined to a narrow border that disappears beneath its outer panels. Its maker seems to have considered modest presentation part of the plating's purpose.
sc_wraps: These servo housings have been maintained with uncommon patience. Small, orderly repairs follow the same pattern around both joints, giving ordinary scuffing the quiet dignity of a repeated observance.
scar_cuirass: Dented chassis plating carried through a hundred bouts.
scraplock_l3: Oil has darkened this sensor package into an irregular map of old spills. One corner has been bound so often that it retains its knot even when the housing is set flat.
scraplock_w2: Bent salvage plates overlap across this CZ-220 plating, beaten back into shape with little regard for their old purpose. Underneath, robust straps provide the order that the outer metal lacks.
scraplock_w3: A servo driven by a small hydraulic press that locks the arm in place on impact.
scraplock_w4: The gripper digits of these servos are scarred by work among stubborn clamps and scrap. Their pads have been reinforced again at precisely the spots where a load refuses to let go.
seeker_gloves: The gripper tips of these servos are lightly scuffed, while the pads bear the marks of rougher use. They belong as readily beside a careful examination of an old ruin as on the next grip point leading into it.
seeker_tunic: This travelling plating has narrow storage slots set into places a hurried observer might miss. Dust settles into its lowest seams, suggesting that the search for answers has involved a good deal of rolling.
servo_frame: A reinforced exo-frame that shrugs off blows while keeping the unit swinging.
slg_ashline: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Ashline Hushfield Deflector Emitter follows a fixed infiltrator profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_bitterdose: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Bitterglass Doser Power Cell follows a fixed poisoner profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_blackledger: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Black-Ledger Lock Manipulator Servo follows a fixed slicer profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_counterwatch: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Counterwatch Deflector Emitter follows a fixed slicer profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_deadfall: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Deadfall Field Manipulator Servo follows a fixed trapper profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_dockcipher: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Dockside Cipher Manipulator Servo follows a fixed slicer profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_falsebottom: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. False-Bottom Keyfield Deflector Emitter follows a fixed slicer profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_gravewire: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Gravewire Utility Power Cell follows a fixed trapper profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_lastcover: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Last-Cover Deflector Emitter follows a fixed tradecraft profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_moonstep: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Moonless-Step Drive Unit follows a fixed infiltrator profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_rimeinject: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Rimevenom Injector Power Cell follows a fixed poisoner profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_smugcourtesy: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Smuggler's Courtesy Power Cell follows a fixed tradecraft profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_tombfilter: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Tombspore Filter Drive Unit follows a fixed poisoner profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_tripline: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Tripline Field Manipulator Servo follows a fixed trapper profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
slg_ventmouse: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a sealed lockbox. Vent-Mouse Drive Unit follows a fixed infiltrator profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
sm_gloves: Soft inner seals keep these servos quiet even when held motionless for a long time. Their modest housing markings recall a practice in which attention matters more than display.
sm_tunic: The panels of this plating settle easily whether the unit is at rest or in motion. A patient pattern of hidden welds gives an otherwise modest shell the feeling of something prepared for long contemplation.
smth_armor_1: Simple, well-fitted plating prepared for the first demands of a smith's working life. Its reinforced seams make clear that neat equipment and honest labor need not be strangers.
smth_armor_2: This plating has been cut with the practical independence of a frontier workshop in mind. Its fittings are easy to reach, and its strongest seams lie where a distant replacement would be most inconvenient.
smth_armor_3: The formal lines of this plating remain tidy without concealing its working purpose. Its maker has given an accomplished craftsperson something suitable for meeting a patron before returning to the bench.
smth_armor_4: The panels of this plating settle with an unexpectedly easy grace. Its careful interior construction is the sort of quiet accomplishment a smith notices after spending years learning to make stubborn things fit.
smth_armor_5: Patient, closely worked seams give this plating an enduring shape. It looks intended to remain in a craftsperson's workshop long after newer fashions have passed through the door.
soulasc_l3: An ash-colored sensor package with scorched straps and a surprisingly careful inner seam. The neat work beneath its battered surface suggests that somebody prepared for Korriban's trials without expecting to emerge looking immaculate.
soulasc_w2: The recessed joints of this plating retain a reddish cast beneath their dark finish. Soot follows every hammer mark, preserving the labor of the forge like ink caught in a seal.
soulasc_w3: A servo crusted with cooled slag from the forge it once guarded.
soulasc_w4: These servos smell faintly of old hide warmed too close to a furnace. Their broad plates have been polished by use rather than a craftsman's finishing rag.
spark_gloves: Tiny scorch marks pepper the housing plates of these servos. They have been repaired carefully enough to remain useful, though their owner never seems to have found a reason to stop working near the next spark.
spirit_hide: Rite-marked hide plating that steadies body and will.
stg_borrowcred: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Borrowed-Credential Manipulator Servo follows a fixed tradecraft profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_causalkey: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Causal-Key Manipulator Servo follows a fixed slicer profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_contwatch: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Continuity Watch Sensor Package follows a fixed trapper profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_diploghost: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Diplomatic Ghost Sensor Package follows a fixed infiltrator profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_echokey: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Echo-Key Sensor Manipulator Servo follows a fixed tradecraft profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_hushmesh: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Hush-Mesh Chassis Plating follows a fixed infiltrator profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_nightroot: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Nightroot Filter Sensor Package follows a fixed poisoner profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_nullfoot: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Null-Footprint Chassis Plating follows a fixed tradecraft profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_raivordose: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Raivor Microdoser Manipulator Servo follows a fixed poisoner profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stg_sabotvisor: Purpose-built clandestine equipment recovered from a field terminal cache. Sabotage Pattern Sensor Package follows a fixed trapper profile and requires Chassis training rather than Espionage rank.
stillair_gloves: These servos are unusually quiet when their grippers flex, with loose wiring tucked beneath the housing plates. Their maker favored the small comforts of stillness over any striking ornament.
stw_ghostline: A fixed-pattern ghostline experimental blaster mount recovered from a burned field terminal. Its tuned internals favor decisive field handling without relying on unstable random modifications.
stw_groundloop: A fixed-pattern ground-loop baton shock prod recovered from a burned field terminal. Its tuned internals favor decisive field operation without relying on unstable random modifications.
stw_longwatch: A fixed-pattern longwatch coil blaster mount recovered from a burned field terminal. Its tuned internals favor decisive field handling without relying on unstable random modifications.
stw_nulllattice: A fixed-pattern null-lattice suppressor mount recovered from a burned field terminal. Its tuned internals favor decisive field handling without relying on unstable random modifications.
stw_quietcarb: A fixed-pattern quieting blaster mount recovered from a burned field terminal. Its tuned internals favor decisive field handling without relying on unstable random modifications.
stw_relaybreak: A fixed-pattern relaybreaker shock prod recovered from a burned field terminal. Its tuned internals favor decisive field use without relying on unstable random modifications.
stw_surveycoil: A fixed-pattern surveyor coil blaster mount recovered from a burned field terminal. Its tuned internals favor decisive field handling without relying on unstable random modifications.
sup_gloves: Fine welds and substantial housing plates make these servos look expensive without relying on conspicuous decoration. The finish holds up to close inspection, which is often where grand names begin to lose their authority.
sup_tunic: This plating combines a formal outline with unusually careful interior work. Every visible seam seems deliberate, as though the technician expected it to represent its droid before a word was spoken.
sur_gloves: These servos have spare cable ties tucked inside their housings and repairs laid over the most exposed seams. They were made with the sensible assumption that help might be several days away.
sur_tunic: This field plating has been planned around weather, scuffing, and the need to carry small necessities. Its extra welds are concentrated where a distant technician would be least convenient to replace it.
suture_gloves: Fine seams keep these servos close around the gripper tips. Repeated cleaning has softened the hide plating, but has not quite removed every faint mark left by difficult work at a medical bench.
sysshut_l3: Thick seals run down the sides of this close-fitting sensor package, brushing against the audio pickups. Small repairs mark the places where communication leads once snagged its housing.
sysshut_w2: This service plating has an untidy collection of replacement fasteners. Each fits, but few match, suggesting an owner accustomed to solving the problem in front of them with whatever was available.
sysshut_w3: A servo hiding a kill switch that can freeze hostile machinery.
sysshut_w4: The housing plates of these servos close with stout, stubborn clasps. Even when empty, their tightly worked grippers look as though they are waiting to turn one last lock.
tarnapexmawda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Tarn Apex Maw.
tarnapexmawdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Tarn Apex Maw.
thermdet_l1: Pale residue has settled into the straps of this cold-weather sensor package. Its front has been reinforced where a demolition worker would repeatedly push it back before examining a charge.
thermdet_l8: The backs of these servos are scuffed, but the gripper tips have been kept fastidiously clean. Whoever fitted them treated the difference between rough use and delicate work as a matter of survival.
thermdet_w1: Heavy welds secure the storage bays of this field plating, leaving little room for their contents to shift. On Hutlar, even familiar explosive work has to accommodate stiff actuators and an uncooperative cold.
thermdet_w3: A reinforced servo fitted by demolitions specialists, its plating scorched and pitted from close work with thermal detonators.
thermlancerda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Thermal Lancer Qel.
thermlancerdb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Thermal Lancer Qel.
thornhide: Barbed hide plating that punishes the careless.
tidecall_pendant: A drop of deep-water pearl on a logic board bound with woven kelp-fiber cord. Dac City gives one to those who turn back a threat to the reefs.
time_bracer: A servo with a built-in chronometer that keeps perfect time.
tit_armor: The broad plates of this plating have an imposing, almost architectural outline. Beneath them, patient fitting work makes room for the droid's own frame rather than simply building a monument around it.
tit_bracer: A massive servo built for units with the strength to carry it.
totem_charm: A servo bound with a totem that focuses the droid while rattling prey.
tran_gloves: These servos are understated until the grippers move, revealing a careful arrangement of small, flexible panels. Their quality lies in work that would be easy to miss on a sales counter.
tran_tunic: This plating's outer simplicity conceals a meticulous pattern of internal seams. It feels like a technician's final answer to a problem they have spent a long time refining.
triagewardenda: Battle-scarred servo recovered from Triage Warden Kessa.
triagewardendb: Reinforced chassis plating recovered from Triage Warden Kessa.
unbrbeast_l1: Rain and sun have faded this Dathomiri sensor package unevenly. Its bindings have been renewed without trimming away the older cord, as though throwing out anything still serviceable would concede too much.
unbrbeast_l8: Tightly woven cords bind the arm joints of these rugged hide-plated servos. The knots have held long enough to press flat against the casing, resisting the repeated pull of a working grip.
unbrbeast_w1: Old scars remain visible beneath the plating's reinforced hide panels. Repair cords crisscross its straps, keeping the whole together through a succession of journeys that were hard on everything else.
unbrbeast_w3: A servo bound with hide and claw from an untamed beast.
unmovctr_l3: The raised ridges of this desert sensor package have been bleached nearly white. A surprisingly stout knot anchors its straps, giving the light plating the look of something much harder to move.
unmovctr_w2: This plating sits low and close, its straps repeatedly shortened around the midsection. Its owner preferred a secure fit to comfort, judging by the deep marks where the clasps rested.
unmovctr_w3: A dense servo as solid and unyielding as bedrock.
unmovctr_w4: Long pressure marks run across the gripper pads of these servos. The plating has been replaced around them rather than over them, preserving the exact shape of a grip their owner trusted.
untinst_l1: Hide strips fringe this hunting sensor package's lower edge. The loose ends mingle with shadows and undergrowth, moving just a little after the droid has stopped.
untinst_l8: Thick cord reinforces this servo where the gripper joins the arm. The knots have been worked deep into the hide by use, leaving no delicate seam for a hurried grasp to find.
untinst_w1: This hide plating preserves more of its material's roughness than a city workshop would tolerate. Its fastening cords are just as practical, made to be repaired far from a shop or a supply crate.
untinst_w3: A light manipulator servo that never slows a fighter's instincts.
val_gloves: The outer housing of this servo has been dressed carefully around older repairs. It suggests an owner who would rather keep reliable equipment presentable than trade it for something with no history.
val_tunic: This plating has a disciplined, upright cut without the insignia of any particular command. Its carefully maintained finish gives the impression of a unit determined to look ready when called upon.
vet_bul_armor: Heavy sections overlap across this plating in closely fitted layers. Scratches gather along its exposed edges, leaving the recessed surfaces with the quiet look of shelter behind a wall.
vet_bul_bracer: A heavy manipulator servo fitted by veterans who have stood guard through many assaults.
vet_chn_gloves: This servo carries fine welds that seem almost incidental until they repeat on both arms. Its owner may recognize meaning in the pattern that an ordinary customer would simply call good workmanship.
vet_chn_tunic: Plating with a reserved outline and thoughtful, concealed details. The storage slots and ties lie where a practised technician expects to find them, without interrupting the quiet lines of its panels.
vet_skm_gloves: The housing of this servo is rubbed bright around its fastenings. Its substantial gripper suggests equipment bolted on before hard work rather than saved until the work is over.
vet_skm_tunic: Reinforced seams run down the upper edges and sides of this field plating. It has a decisive, forward-set cut, with little loose metal to announce a movement before the droid makes it.
vitrupt_l3: The casing of this sensor package has been rubbed almost smooth at the front. Its bare, stripped-down construction suggests the few personal belongings someone might be allowed to keep in a detention block.
vitrupt_w2: This institutional plating has lost its original markings beneath scratches and repeated cleaning. The old holes in its straps give a better account of its owners than any surviving inventory stamp.
vitrupt_w3: A manipulator servo fitted with restraints that bind a foe who gets too close.
vitrupt_w4: This servo has been mended more than once along the outer housing. Its blunt, practical construction belongs to work where pockets are emptied and questions are expected to receive immediate answers.
viv_gloves: A rich finish gives this servo an unexpected liveliness in poor light. Its gripper is plainer and sturdier, keeping the most demanding work away from the part made to be admired.
viv_tunic: Carefully chosen panels give this plating a lively play of color across its seams. The technician kept its construction practical, allowing the droid to remain memorable without dressing for a static portrait.
warband_legs: A heavy drive unit plated with krayt-bone scales, fitted only to the units of the most seasoned warriors of a Tusken war band.
ward_vest: Charm-warded plating that keeps the droid standing.
worldbrk_l3: Loose wires trail from this scavenger's sensor package, trimmed back only where they might catch machinery. The rest have been allowed to endure, like much else put back into service on CZ-220.
worldbrk_w2: The panels of this plating look as though they came from different sides of the same industrial disaster. Replacement straps hold them together around a darkened central fitting that has seen considerable heat.
worldbrk_w3: A servo-driven gripper arm that adds crushing force to every swing.
worldbrk_w4: The gripper housing of this servo is layered with salvage leather and careful repairs. A trace of metal dust emerges whenever it flexes, refusing to surrender the workshop entirely.
yard_plate: Layered ablative plating bolted over the shell; heavy, but it turns aside a great deal of punishment.
